actions.callFlow.description: Call a flow that has "Callable Flow" trigger
actions.callFlow.props.flowId.descriptio: The flow to execute. Published flows with a "Callable Flow" trigger appear here; disabled flows are marked "(inactive)" and cannot be executed until they are enabled.
actions.callFlow.props.mode.description: Choose Simple for key-value or Advanced for JSON.
actions.returnResponse.description: Return response to the original flow
actions.returnResponse.props.mode.descri: Choose Simple for key-value or Advanced for JSON.
actions.streamCsvToSubflows.description: Stream a CSV and call a subflow once per batch of rows, without loading the whole file into memory.
actions.streamCsvToSubflows.props.batchS: How many CSV rows to send in each subflow call. Between 1 and 10000.
actions.streamCsvToSubflows.props.extraD: Optional data sent to every subflow call alongside the batch rows. Reference the output of a previous step.
actions.streamCsvToSubflows.props.file.d: The CSV to stream. Accepts a URL, an uploaded file, or a file from a previous step. It is streamed, not loaded into memory.
actions.streamCsvToSubflows.props.subflo: The subflow to call for each batch. Published flows with a "Callable Flow" trigger appear here; disabled flows are marked "(inactive)".
